inlines.text: 从今天（11月13日）起，Apple HomeView将在部分地区的Apple Store零售店、Apple Store在线商店和Apple Store app中发售。1 Apple HomeView为客户带来欣赏娱乐内容、保持联系和管理家居的新方式，这一切都由搭载Siri AI的Apple Intelligence驱动。

blocks.text: 配备惊艳的7英寸Liquid Retina显示屏，并搭载Siri AI——这是Siri的全新版本，能力大幅增强，对话更自然——Apple HomeView旨在成为家庭的中心，并对家中每个人都做到个性化。2 它将娱乐、联系和智能家居管理汇聚于一处，从播放音乐、发起FaceTime通话，到家庭监控和通过语音控制实现免手动自动化，全都内置隐私与安全保护。3

inlines.text: 配备惊艳的7英寸Liquid Retina显示屏，并搭载Siri AI——这是Siri的全新版本，能力大幅增强，对话更自然——Apple HomeView旨在成为家庭的中心，并对家中每个人都做到个性化。2 它将娱乐、联系和智能家居管理汇聚于一处，从播放音乐、发起FaceTime通话，到家庭监控和通过语音控制实现免手动自动化，全都内置隐私与安全保护。3

blocks.text: HomeView可通过面部识别最多六个人，并调整显示他们在信息、FaceTime通话、日历、提醒事项和查找中的个人内容。借助Siri AI广泛的世界知识，用户可以询问几乎任何话题并获得详细回答。Siri AI还具备屏幕感知能力，因此能根据用户屏幕上的内容回答问题或执行操作。与支持Apple Intelligence的iPhone或iPad配对后，Siri AI可以利用用户的个人上下文，例如日历、信息以及各app中的相关信息，提供更个性化的回答。它还能跨app执行操作，帮助用户完成任务。

UPDATE November 13, 2026
Featuring a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display along with Siri AI, Apple HomeView is designed to be the center of the home and personal to everyone in it.

inlines.text: Featuring a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display along with Siri AI, Apple HomeView is designed to be the center of the home and personal to everyone in it.

blocks.text: Beginning today, November 13, Apple HomeView is available for purchase at Apple Store locations, on the Apple Store online, and in the Apple Store app in select regions.1 Apple HomeView gives customers a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage their home, all powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI.

inlines.text: Beginning today, November 13, Apple HomeView is available for purchase at Apple Store locations, on the Apple Store online, and in the Apple Store app in select regions.1 Apple HomeView gives customers a new way to enjoy entertainment, stay connected, and manage their home, all powered by Apple Intelligence with Siri AI.

blocks.text: Featuring a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display along with Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable and conversational, Apple HomeView is designed to be the center of the home and personal to everyone in it.2 It brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all with privacy and security built in.3

inlines.text: Featuring a stunning 7-inch Liquid Retina display along with Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri that is profoundly more capable and conversational, Apple HomeView is designed to be the center of the home and personal to everyone in it.2 It brings entertainment, connection, and smart home management together in one place, from playing music and making FaceTime calls to home monitoring and hands-free automations with voice control — all with privacy and security built in.3

blocks.text: HomeView recognizes up to six people by face and adapts to show their personal content in Messages, FaceTime, Calendar, Reminders, and Find My. And with Siri AI’s broad world knowledge, users can ask about virtually any topic and get a detailed answer. Siri AI also has onscreen awareness, so it can answer questions or take actions based on the content on the user’s screen. When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, Siri AI can draw on a user’s personal context, such as their Calendar, Messages, and relevant information across their apps, to provide more personalized responses. And it can take action across apps to help get things done.

blocks.text: Designed to fit in any space, HomeView can be placed on a tabletop as the center of the home or wall-mounted to fit in spaces like the entryway or hallway. Both models work seamlessly with the Home app to manage settings, automations, and smart home accessories. The tabletop model is available in four beautiful colors: silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray. The wall-mounted model is available in two: silver and space gray.
